title: Exact open-closed sequence and constructibility in the native Weil sheaf heart
statement:
Fix a finite field $k_0$, an algebraic closure $k$, a prime $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}(k_0)$ and $\Omega=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$. Let $X$ be a quasi-compact quasi-separated $k_0$-scheme locally of finite type [def-weil-quasi-separated-morphism, def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Let $j:U\to X$ be a quasi-compact open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion] and $i:Z\to X$ a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion], over $k_0$, with complementary images. Write $\bar W=W\times_{k_0}k$ and use exactly the coefficient sheaves $B_W$, module categories $\mathcal A_W$, fixed-pair categories $\mathcal W_W$, Frobenius actions and constructibility condition of [def-sf-native-weil-derived-framework], for $W=X,U,Z$.

The canonical coefficient maps $\bar j^{-1}B_X\to B_U$ and $\bar i^{-1}B_X\to B_Z$ are isomorphisms of ring sheaves compatible with the geometric Frobenius comparisons. The categories $\mathcal W_W$ are abelian, and their forgetful functors to $\mathcal A_W$ are exact and reflect exact sequences. On these native sheaf categories let $P=j^*$ and $Q=i^*$ be the actual inverse images, $J=j_!$ the actual open extension by zero, and $I=i_*$ the ordinary direct image, with the Frobenius structures specified in [def-sf-native-weil-derived-framework]. All four functors are additive and preserve finite limits and finite colimits. They preserve the property that the underlying $B_W$-module is constructible. There are adjunctions $J\dashv P$ and $Q\dashv I$ whose units and counits have the usual sheaf-adjunction maps as their carriers. For every $M\in\mathcal W_X$, those actual counit and unit maps give a natural short exact sequence in $\mathcal W_X$,
$$0\longrightarrow JP(M)\xrightarrow{\varepsilon_M}M\xrightarrow{\eta_M}IQ(M)\longrightarrow0.$$
The assertions include empty $U$ or $Z$ and nonreduced closed complements.

source.place: Tag 09AH, lemma-ses-associated-to-open, and Tag 09BM, lemma-closed-immersion-complement-retrocompact-exact, adapted to native ring modules and Frobenius fixed pairs. Native coefficient comparison: lean/WeilConjectures/SixFunctors/ProEtale/Adic/UpperStar.lean, upperStarAdicConstantSheafIso; immersion exactness: Adic/ClosedImmersion.lean, preservesFiniteColimits_adicLowerStar_of_isCompl; Weil lift: WeilSheaf/Category.lean and WeilSheaf/OpenImmersion.lean. proof.text: The canonical coefficient morphisms are isomorphisms and monoid morphisms by the existing native pullback API. For any square a b = c d, cancel the composition isomorphism for a,b, use upperStarAdicConstantSheafHom_comp on both sides and transport the canonical map along the equality of composites. Specialize first to two explicit structure morphisms over the finite field in the private proved helper coefficient_frobenius_square, then apply it to j and i. Keep the geometric-fiber and Frobenius constructors locally irreducible while checking this specialization, to avoid unfolding the base-change construction. This is the private proved helper coefficient_square; no immersion or finiteness assumption is required for this calculation. Proof-only imports expose alternate ring and Grothendieck-abelian instances; their priorities are locally lowered so this helper and the unchanged public statement use identical coefficient instances, avoiding expensive definitional conversions.

Use the native abelian structures and the finite-limit and finite-colimit preservation of IsoAlgebra.forget at X,U,Z. Mathlib ShortComplex.exact_map_iff_of_faithful and ShortExact.shortExact_map_iff identify exactness and short exactness with their carrier versions, giving all three reflection assertions.

The native upperStar and extensionByZero functors already have additive and finite-limit/colimit instances. For the closed lowerStar, use the native specialization ProEtaleWeilSheaf.preservesFiniteColimits_lowerStar_of_isCompl of ringed localization, with Scheme.Hom.isCompl_range_geometricFiberMap transporting the complement; finite limits and additivity are already instances. Constructibility of the pullbacks is IsAdicConstructibleSheaf.upperStar, that of open extension is WeilSheaf.isAdicConstructibleSheaf_extensionByZero, and that of closed direct image is IsAdicConstructibleSheaf.adicLowerStar_of_isClosedImmersion in Adic.ClosedLowerStar. Its locally Noetherian geometric target is the existing isLocallyNoetherian_geometricFiber instance. Local finite type of U and Z follows by composing each immersion with the structure morphism. Thus the exactness and constructibility assertion is assembled without a new stratification theorem.

For the closed adjunction use the existing ProEtaleWeilSheaf.upperStarLowerStarAdjunction. Construct the open adjunction with IsoAlgebra.mapOfNatIsoLeftAdjunction: its hypotheses are the existing mate equality for upperStar/lowerStar, compatibility of adicOpenImmersionLowerShriekToLowerStar with Frobenius, and its transpose formula. This is the same concrete lifting construction used by the proved nativeBasicComparisons module, not an application of its theorem. All four carrier formulas are definitional equalities. In particular no normalization of a new Frobenius comparison is needed.

Write P=j*, Q=i*, J=j!, I=i_*. The native specialization of localization gives P I=0, Q J=0, the invertible open unit and closed counit, and joint detection of zero by P,Q. The first and last are ProEtaleWeilSheaf.isZero_upperStar_obj_lowerStar_obj and isZero_of_isZero_upperStar_of_isCompl; Q J=0 is obtained by faithful forgetting from isZero_adicUpperStar_adicOpenImmersionLowerShriek on the geometric fibers. Invertibility of the open unit is reflected by IsoAlgebra.forget. The composite of the actual counit epsilon and unit eta is zero by naturality of the open counit: P(eta_M) has zero target P I Q M, so J P(eta_M)=0, and the naturality square identifies epsilon_M followed by eta_M with zero.

The private proved categorical helper shortExact_of_localization carries out this argument. For S=(J P M -> M -> I Q M), apply Q: its first term is zero and its second arrow is invertible by the closed counit and the triangle identity. Apply P: its first arrow is invertible by the open unit and the triangle identity and its last term is zero. Both image complexes are short exact by Mathlib ShortComplex.exact_iff_mono and exact_iff_epi. The private proved helper shortExact_of_jointly_detected now detects short exactness: exact P,Q preserve the kernel of S.f, cokernel of S.g and homology of S; these are zero after either functor and hence zero by joint detection. This proves monicity, epicity and exactness of S. The maps are natural because they are actual adjunction maps. All arguments allow empty pieces and nonreduced closed immersions.
